subject: Pilot benchmark window, competitive bakeoff, and renewal timeline
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@trove.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Trove Procurement <procurement@trove.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot benchmark window and timing for renewal

Hi Priyom,

Contract with Redwood is up for renewal in early November and we've been asked to run a quick competitive validation before the renewal decision. VeloxAI has been invited to the same bakeoff window.

Can Redwood run a short benchmark against our production-ish dataset (I'll attach a redacted sample) and provide a mutual action plan that includes:
- a 2-week benchmark window (we prefer the first week of Oct)
- expected token throughput and p50/p90 latency targets at our peak (we will send hourly qps distribution)
- a proposal for capacity uplift if we decide to accelerate (target: +30% production capacity)
- SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest confirmation for procurement

Procurement will also want a short commercial term proposal (list price + any uplift discounts) and a simple MOU if we decide to run a live benchmark on your infra.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of availability and what you need from us to kick this off.

Thanks,
Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of ML Ops, Trove
ellen@trove.ai

Attachment: trove-benchmark-sample-README.txt (TXT, 1KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@trove.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot benchmark window and timing for renewal

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the sample. We're available for a live benchmark the week of Oct 4 (Oct 4–11 is doable). Quick confirmation on two items and then we'll ship a mutual action plan:

1) Dataset: the redacted sample looks good — please send the hourly qps distribution and a small set of long-tail examples (as you mentioned).
2) Success metrics: is p50 <150ms and p90 <=300ms acceptable as a baseline target? we can tune to your SLA if you prefer a different target.

What we'll offer for the bakeoff:
- a hosted Dedicated pool provisioned for the benchmark (you'll get an isolated pool with exact-to-production config)
- a 2-week runbook and an ops-on-call window for test-day support (we'll include our engineer Karthik and CSM Marissa)
- an initial commercial term: uplift discount options for committed capacity (we'll put a formal number in the proposal)

I'll circulate a short mutual action plan and the benchmark runbook by EOD today. If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts, Naomi on our trust team will be on the thread.

Next steps: I'll send the MAPl and runbook; can you confirm the preferred benchmark start date (Oct 4) and who on your side will run coordination?

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri y o m@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-plan.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: Ellen Park <ellen@trove.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Trove Procurement <procurement@trove.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot benchmark window and timing for renewal

Thanks — Oct 4 works. Coordinator on our side is Jaime Soto (cc'ed offline) and procurement is the address above. A couple of clarifications:

- VeloxAI is already scheduled to run a baseline next week; they told us they can hit the throughput targets with a slightly degraded p90. We expect side-by-side numbers.
- Procurement will need SOC2 Type II documentation and an attestation of encryption-at-rest + KMS integration.
- For the benchmark to be meaningful, we need Redwood to demonstrate steady-state throughput at ~2x our current peak QPS for a 2-hour stress window during the run.

If Redwood can commit to the stress-window run and share a commercial uplift discount for a 12-month committed uplift (+30% baseline), we'll be in a good position to include Redwood in the shortlist.

Ellen

Attachment: trove-deep-traffic-sample.csv (CSV, 250KB) — sent offline via SFTP

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Trove bakeoff plan — quick internal coordination

Karthik / Marissa — Ellen confirmed Oct 4–11, wants a two-hour stress window at 2x peak QPS. Procurement will request SOC2 artifacts; Naomi, can you prep the certs?

Ask for Karthik:
- Can you prepare a benchmark harness that uses our prefix/KV cache + quantized model path? Target p50 <150ms, p90 <=300ms on their redacted sample.
- Plan to reserve a small Dedicated pool sized for +30% uplift; we should propose a temporary burst at no charge for the 2-hour stress window as a pre-sales concession.
- Runbook: include scripts, env, and the data ingest steps (keep PII redacted).

Commercially I'll draft a two-option offer: 1) 12-month committed uplift at a 30% discount vs list for the uplift amount; 2) a 6-month trial uplift with a smaller discount + migration assistance credits.

We need the runbook and price sheet by EOD Wednesday so I can send the final proposal to Ellen on Thursday.

Thanks — Priyom

(Internal note: keep the temporary free burst in the proposal as leverage; VeloxAI may not offer cutover assistance.)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trove bakeoff plan — quick internal coordination

Priyom / Marissa — confirmed. Technical plan high level:
- Model: use q4_0 quantized variant for benchmark to reduce memory footprint and improve throughput.
- Runtime: enable continuous batching with target batch size tuned to their qps distribution; use KV cache priming before the stress window.
- Dedicated pool: recommend 6 x a100-equivalent GPUs for the baseline benchmark, with a temporary 2x burst (on pre-provisioned warm nodes) for the stress window.
- Telemetry: we'll enable token-level tracing and the per-route latency dashboard so Trove gets raw p50/p90 numbers.

Ops ask: need access to the redacted sample and the long-tail examples by EOD Tuesday. I'll attach the benchmark-runbook and a quick estimate for cost/latency per scenario.

Attachment: benchmark-runbook.md (MD, 8 pages)

I'll prepare a short internal test script to validate the 2x stress profile tomorrow. Once validated I'll hand off scripts and dashboards to Marissa for the customer-facing runbook.

Karthik

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@trove.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Trove Procurement <procurement@trove.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood benchmark & commercial proposal — Trove (Oct 4–11)

Hi Ellen — thanks for confirming the window. Please find a concise proposal and next steps below: 

1) Benchmark schedule and scope- Oct 4–11 live benchmark (Oct 8: 2-hour stress window at 2x peak QPS)- We will run against your redacted sample and long-tail examples; we'll provide dashboards with p50/p90 and token-level traces

2) Technical commitment- Target baseline: p50 < 150ms, p90 <= 300ms for the production-like workload using our q4_0 path and caching strategy- Dedicated pool: we'll provision the nodes and run the stress window on pre-warmed capacity (no cold-start penalty)

3) Commercial options- Option A (recommended): 12-month committed uplift for +30% baseline capacity at a 20% discount on uplift usage; includes one-time migration assistance credit and 4 weeks of prioritized SRE support during rollout- Option B: 6-month trial uplift with a 10% discount and migration assistance credits pro-rated

4) Pre-sales concession- We'll provide a one-time free burst (2 hours at 2x peak) during the Oct 8 stress window to remove benchmarking variability and demonstrate steady-state throughput

5) Procurement requirements- Naomi has attached SOC2 Type II artifacts and a KMS integration note. Please confirm any additional evidence you need.

Next steps: If this looks good I propose a short MOU to lock the Oct 4 start and the free-burst concession; I've attached the commercial proposal and the runbook. If agreeable, please sign the MOU (DocuSign link below) and we'll schedule a pre-run tech sync with Karthik and Jaime.

DocuSign (MOU): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/mou/TROVE-MOU-2026
Attachments: redwood-benchmark-plan.pdf, commercial-proposal-trove-2026.xlsx, benchmark-runbook.md

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri y o m@redwood.ai
